summary: This document records the Iceberg Spark integration updates, covering new features such as DSv2 validation, geometry bounds in Parquet writers, and runtime filtering improvements, along with bug fixes for ORC variant handling and vectorized reads. The discussion centers on how to interpret Parquet files that contain field IDs for only some columns, a situation that current Iceberg readers handle inconsistently. The discussion examines the ambiguity of the "deterministic" flag for UDFs in stored expressions, noting that inconsistent results across engines can break checks, indexes, and derived columns. The discussion centers on adding a stream-from-snapshot option to Spark streaming reads, allowing an initial full snapshot load before incremental processing.
